			if (CreateTxdImageForVideoCard()) {
				CStreaming::Shutdown();
				CdStreamAddImage("MODELS\\TXD.IMG");
				CStreaming::Init2();
			}
		}
	} else
		CStreaming::Init2();
#else
	CStreaming::Init2();
#endif
}

void
CStreaming::ReInit(void)
{
	int i;
	CStreaming::FlushRequestList();
	CStreaming::DeleteAllRwObjects();
	CStreaming::RemoveAllUnusedModels();
	for(i = 0; i < MODELINFOSIZE; i++)
		if(CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(i) && ms_aInfoForModel[i].m_flags & STREAMFLAGS_SCRIPTOWNED)
			SetMissionDoesntRequireModel(i);
	CStreaming::ms_disableStreaming = false;
}

void
CStreaming::Shutdown(void)
{
	// Recordings are owned by their own system, but streamed through this one,
	// so they are released here while the streaming buffers are still alive.
	CVehicleRecording::ShutDown();

	RwFreeAlign(ms_pStreamingBuffer[0]);
	ms_streamingBufferSize = 0;
	if(ms_pExtraObjectsDir) {
		delete ms_pExtraObjectsDir;
#ifdef FIX_BUGS
		ms_pExtraObjectsDir = nil;
#endif
	}
}

#ifndef MASTER
uint64 timeProcessingTXD;
uint64 timeProcessingDFF;
#endif

#ifdef ANDROID
#include "OptimizationConfig.h"
namespace {
static float s_mobileRamLodScale = 1.0f;
static int s_mobileVehReqBudget = OPT_vehicleRequestsPerFrame;
static int s_mobileAsyncReqBudget = OPT_asyncRequestsPerFrame;
static uint32 s_lastMemSampleFrame = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
static size_t s_cachedAvailRamMB = 1024;
static size_t s_cachedTotalRamMB = 4096;

// Memory pressure state (analysis ch. 2, 3, 9)
static bool s_inMitigation = false;
static bool s_inCritical = false;
static int   s_mitigationTimerMs = 0;
static int   s_recoveryTimerMs = 0;
static float s_targetDistanceScale = 1.0f;

static size_t
SampleAndroidAvailRamMB(void)
{
	uint32 fc = CTimer::GetFrameCounter();
	if(s_lastMemSampleFrame != 0xFFFFFFFFu && (uint32)(fc - s_lastMemSampleFrame) < 60u)
		return s_cachedAvailRamMB;
	s_lastMemSampleFrame = fc;

	FILE *fp = fopen("/proc/meminfo", "rb");
	if(!fp)
		return s_cachedAvailRamMB;
	char buf[512];
	size_t n = fread(buf, 1, sizeof(buf) - 1, fp);
	fclose(fp);
	buf[n] = '\0';

	const char *p = strstr(buf, "MemAvailable:");
	if(p){
		p += sizeof("MemAvailable:") - 1;
		while(*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;
		unsigned long kb = strtoul(p, nil, 10);
		if(kb > 0)
			s_cachedAvailRamMB = (size_t)(kb / 1024ul);
	}
	p = strstr(buf, "MemTotal:");
	if(p){
		p += sizeof("MemTotal:") - 1;
		while(*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;
		unsigned long kb = strtoul(p, nil, 10);
		if(kb > 0)
			s_cachedTotalRamMB = (size_t)(kb / 1024ul);
	}
	return s_cachedAvailRamMB;
}

// Select memory budget from the scaling table (analysis ch. 8.5)
static size_t
GetMemoryBudgetMb(void)
{
	size_t ramGb = s_cachedTotalRamMB / 1024;
	for(int i = OPT_memoryBudgetScalingCount - 1; i >= 0; i--){
		if(ramGb >= OPT_memoryBudgetScaling[i].minimumRamGb)
			return OPT_memoryBudgetScaling[i].budgetMb;
	}
	return OPT_memoryBudgetScaling[0].budgetMb;
}

static void
UpdateMobileStreamingHeadroom(void)
{
	size_t availMB = SampleAndroidAvailRamMB();
	size_t budgetMB = GetMemoryBudgetMb();
	float headroomMb = (float)(budgetMB - (s_cachedTotalRamMB - availMB));

	// Determine target distance scale (analysis ch. 2, 3, 9)
	// Hysteresis: enter mitigation when headroom < 32MB, leave when > 48MB
	// Enter critical when headroom < 8MB, leave when > 24MB
	float targetScale = 1.0f;
	bool wantMitigation = false;
	bool wantCritical = false;

	if(s_inCritical){
		if(headroomMb > OPT_criticalLeaveHeadroomMb)
			wantMitigation = true; // drop from critical to mitigation
		else
			wantCritical = true;
	}else if(s_inMitigation){
		if(headroomMb > OPT_mitigationLeaveHeadroomMb)
			wantMitigation = false; // leave mitigation
		else
			wantMitigation = true;
		if(headroomMb < OPT_criticalEnterHeadroomMb)
			wantCritical = true;
	}else{
		if(headroomMb < OPT_criticalEnterHeadroomMb)
			wantCritical = true;
		else if(headroomMb < OPT_mitigationEnterHeadroomMb)
			wantMitigation = true;
	}

	if(wantCritical)
		targetScale = OPT_criticalDistanceScale;
	else if(wantMitigation)
		targetScale = OPT_mitigationDistanceScale;

	// Delay timers (analysis ch. 3: mitigationDelayMs / recoveryDelayMs)
	int dtMs = (int)(CTimer::GetTimeStepInSeconds() * 1000.0f);
	if(dtMs <= 0) dtMs = 1;

	if(wantCritical){
		s_inMitigation = true;
		s_inCritical = true;
		s_targetDistanceScale = OPT_criticalDistanceScale;
		s_mobileVehReqBudget = OPT_constrainedVehicleRequestsPerFrame;
		s_mobileAsyncReqBudget = OPT_constrainedAsyncRequestsPerFrame;
	}else if(wantMitigation){
		if(!s_inMitigation){
			s_mitigationTimerMs += dtMs;
			if(s_mitigationTimerMs < OPT_mitigationDelayMs)
				targetScale = 1.0f; // wait for delay to elapse
		}
		if(s_mitigationTimerMs >= OPT_mitigationDelayMs || s_inMitigation){
			s_inMitigation = true;
			s_inCritical = false;
			s_targetDistanceScale = OPT_mitigationDistanceScale;
			s_mobileVehReqBudget = OPT_constrainedVehicleRequestsPerFrame;
			s_mobileAsyncReqBudget = OPT_constrainedAsyncRequestsPerFrame;
		}
	}else{
		// No pressure — recover with recoveryDelayMs
		if(s_inMitigation || s_inCritical){
			s_recoveryTimerMs += dtMs;
			if(s_recoveryTimerMs < OPT_recoveryDelayMs)
				targetScale = s_targetDistanceScale; // hold current scale
		}
		if(s_recoveryTimerMs >= OPT_recoveryDelayMs || (!s_inMitigation && !s_inCritical)){
			s_inMitigation = false;
			s_inCritical = false;
			s_mitigationTimerMs = 0;
			s_recoveryTimerMs = 0;
			s_targetDistanceScale = 1.0f;
			s_mobileVehReqBudget = OPT_vehicleRequestsPerFrame;
			s_mobileAsyncReqBudget = OPT_asyncRequestsPerFrame;
		}
	}

	// Gradual scale change (analysis ch. 3: distanceScaleChangePerSecond)
	float dt = Min(CTimer::GetTimeStepInSeconds(), 0.1f);
	if(dt > 0.0f){
		float maxStep = OPT_distanceScaleChangePerSecond * dt;
		float diff = targetScale - s_mobileRamLodScale;
		if(diff > maxStep) diff = maxStep;
		else if(diff < -maxStep) diff = -maxStep;
		s_mobileRamLodScale += diff;
	}

	// Apply farPlaneMarginScale (analysis ch. 3)
	float marginScale = OPT_farPlaneMarginScale;
	CRenderer::ms_lodDistScale = Clamp(FrontEndMenuManager.m_PrefsLOD * s_mobileRamLodScale * marginScale, DRAWDIST_MIN, DRAWDIST_MAX);

	// Vehicle loaded-count targets (analysis ch. 4, 8).
	// The analysis defines vehicleUnloadDistance/ReloadDistance as streaming
	// distances (35/25 m) for the network vehicle system; in this codebase
	// the loaded-vehicle count is adjusted by pressure state instead.
	int32 loadedVehs = CStreaming::ms_numVehiclesLoaded;
	const int32 normalTarget = Min(25, (int32)MAXVEHICLESLOADED);
	if(s_inCritical)
		desiredNumVehiclesLoaded = Min(15, (int32)MAXVEHICLESLOADED);
	else if(s_inMitigation)
		desiredNumVehiclesLoaded = Min(18, (int32)MAXVEHICLESLOADED);
	else if(loadedVehs > normalTarget + 10)
		desiredNumVehiclesLoaded = normalTarget;
	else if(desiredNumVehiclesLoaded < normalTarget)
		desiredNumVehiclesLoaded = normalTarget;
}
} // namespace
#endif

void
CStreaming::Update(void)
{
	CStreamingInfo *si, *prev;
	bool requestedSubway = false;

#ifndef MASTER
	timeProcessingTXD = 0;
	timeProcessingDFF = 0;
#endif

#ifdef ANDROID
	UpdateMobileStreamingHeadroom();
#endif
	UpdateMemoryUsed();

	if(ms_channelError != -1){
		RetryLoadFile(ms_channelError);
		return;
	}

	if(CTimer::GetIsPaused())
		return;

	LoadBigBuildingsWhenNeeded();
#ifdef ANDROID
	if(!ms_disableStreaming)
#else
	if(!ms_disableStreaming && TheCamera.GetPosition().z < 55.0f)
#endif
		AddModelsToRequestList(TheCamera.GetPosition(), 0);

	DeleteFarAwayRwObjects(TheCamera.GetPosition());

	if(!ms_disableStreaming &&
	   ms_numModelsRequested < 5 &&
	   !CRenderer::m_loadingPriority &&
	   CGame::currArea == AREA_MAIN_MAP &&
	   !CReplay::IsPlayingBack()){
		StreamVehiclesAndPeds();
		StreamZoneModels(FindPlayerCoors());
	}

	LoadRequestedModels();

	if(CWorld::Players[0].m_pRemoteVehicle){
		CColStore::AddCollisionNeededAtPosn(FindPlayerCoors());
		CColStore::LoadCollision(CWorld::Players[0].m_pRemoteVehicle->GetPosition());
		CColStore::EnsureCollisionIsInMemory(CWorld::Players[0].m_pRemoteVehicle->GetPosition());
	}else{
		CColStore::LoadCollision(FindPlayerCoors());
		CColStore::EnsureCollisionIsInMemory(FindPlayerCoors());
	}

	// TODO: PrintRequestList
	//if (CPad::GetPad(1)->GetLeftShoulder2JustDown() && CPad::GetPad(1)->GetRightShoulder1() && CPad::GetPad(1)->GetRightShoulder2())
	//	PrintRequestList();

	for(si = ms_endRequestedList.m_prev; si != &ms_startRequestedList; si = prev){
		prev = si->m_prev;
		if((si->m_flags & (STREAMFLAGS_KEEP_IN_MEMORY|STREAMFLAGS_PRIORITY)) == 0)
			RemoveModel(si - ms_aInfoForModel);
	}
}

void
CStreaming::LoadCdDirectory(void)
{
	char dirname[132];
	int i;

#ifdef GTA_PC
	ms_imageOffsets[0] = 0;
	ms_imageOffsets[1] = -1;
	ms_imageOffsets[2] = -1;
	ms_imageOffsets[3] = -1;
	ms_imageOffsets[4] = -1;
	ms_imageOffsets[5] = -1;
	ms_imageSize = GetGTA3ImgSize();
	// PS2 uses CFileMgr::GetCdFile on all IMG files to fill the array
#endif

	i = CdStreamGetNumImages();
	while(i-- >= 1){
		strcpy(dirname, CdStreamGetImageName(i));
		strncpy(strrchr(dirname, '.') + 1, "DIR", 3);
		LoadCdDirectory(dirname, i);
	}

#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
	// The IMG index is final now. Models installed from custom IDEs were
	// paired before creating their TXD slots; also cover native VC building
	// slots replaced by a DFF + same-name TXD from custom/img/. The winners
	// can come from different auto-mounted IMGs; never pick a stock TXD just
	// because its name collides. Leave unpaired IDE and VC multi-LOD alone.
	int paired = 0, rebound = 0;
	for(int model = 0; model < MODELINFOSIZE; model++){
		CBaseModelInfo *mi = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(model);
		if(!mi) continue;
		if(mi->IsBuilding()){
			CSimpleModelInfo *simple = (CSimpleModelInfo*)mi;
			// Leave native VC multi-LOD damaged buildings alone unless custom-owned
			if(!CCustomWorld::OwnsModelSlot(model) &&
			   (simple->m_numAtomics != 1 || simple->m_firstDamaged != 0))
				continue;
		}
		CStreamingInfo &dff = ms_aInfoForModel[model];
		if(!dff.GetCdSize()) continue;
		int image = _GET_INDEX(dff.m_position);
		if(!CCustomModels::IsAutoMountedImage(image)) continue;
		int txd = CTxdStore::FindTxdSlot(mi->GetModelName());
		if(txd < 0) continue;
		CStreamingInfo &texture = ms_aInfoForModel[txd + STREAM_OFFSET_TXD];
		if(!texture.GetCdSize() ||
		   !CCustomModels::IsAutoMountedImage(_GET_INDEX(texture.m_position)))
			continue;
		paired++;
		int oldTxd = mi->GetTxdSlot();
		if(oldTxd != txd){
			if(mi->GetRwObject() || mi->GetNumRefs()) continue;
			mi->SetTexDictionary(mi->GetModelName());
			if(oldTxd >= 0 && CTxdStore::GetParentTxdSlot(txd) < 0 &&
			   (ms_aInfoForModel[oldTxd + STREAM_OFFSET_TXD].GetCdSize() > 0 ||
			    CTxdStore::GetSlot(oldTxd)->texDict != nil))
				CTxdStore::SetTxdParent(txd, oldTxd);
			rebound++;
		}
	}
	REVC_LOG_INFO("custom/img/: %d DFF/TXD same-name pairs confirmed, %d model TXD associations updated", paired, rebound);
#endif

	ms_lastImageRead = 0;
	ms_imageSize /= CDSTREAM_SECTOR_SIZE;
}

void
CStreaming::LoadCdDirectory(const char *dirname, int n)
{
	int fd, lastID;
	uint32 imgSelector;
	int modelId;
	CDirectory::DirectoryInfo direntry;
	char *dot;

	lastID = -1;
	fd = CFileMgr::OpenFile(dirname, "rb");
	if(fd <= 0){
		REVC_LOG_ERROR("Cannot read CD directory %s for IMG %d", dirname, n);
		return;
	}

	int entries = 0, registered = 0, duplicates = 0;
	imgSelector = (uint32)n<<24;
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
	int unknownModels = 0, ignoredTypes = 0, fullTxds = 0;
	bool modelsOnly = CCustomModels::IsAutoMountedImage(n);
	// A large custom/data/maps/ IDE can register ~28k models. Scanning the
	// model-info array for each IMG DFF would be quadratic at boot. This
	// temporary metadata index is rebuilt per directory and freed afterward;
	// it does not retain models or change any resident-asset cache budget.
	customimg::ModelNameIndex modelNames(MAX_MODEL_NAME);
	modelNames.Reserve(MODELINFOSIZE);
	for(int id = 0; id < MODELINFOSIZE; id++) {
		CBaseModelInfo *mi = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(id);
		if(mi) modelNames.Add(mi->GetModelName(), id);
	}
#endif
	assert(sizeof(direntry) == 32);
	while(CFileMgr::Read(fd, (char*)&direntry, sizeof(direntry))){
		entries++;
		bool bAddToStreaming = false;

#ifndef CUSTOM_MODELS
		if(direntry.size > (uint32)ms_streamingBufferSize)
			ms_streamingBufferSize = direntry.size;
#else
		if(!modelsOnly && direntry.size > (uint32)ms_streamingBufferSize)
			ms_streamingBufferSize = direntry.size;
#endif
		direntry.name[23] = '\0';
		dot = strchr(direntry.name, '.');
		if(dot == nil || dot-direntry.name > 20){
			debug("%s is too long\n", direntry.name);
			lastID = -1;
			continue;
		}
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
		// The native streamer receives only DFF/TXD from user IMGs. COL/CLS
		// entries were indexed separately and converted to VC COLL by the
		// custom collision loader; never stream raw SA collision bytes here.
		if(modelsOnly && (dot-direntry.name > 19 || dot[4] != '\0' ||
		   (strncasecmp(dot+1, "DFF", 3) != 0 &&
		    strncasecmp(dot+1, "TXD", 3) != 0))){
			ignoredTypes++;
			lastID = -1;
			continue;
		}
#endif

		*dot = '\0';

		if(strncasecmp(dot+1, "DFF", 3) == 0){
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
			modelId = modelNames.Find(direntry.name);
			// Preserve the game's case-insensitive behavior for rare non-ASCII
			// stock names, which the ASCII-only fast index cannot represent.
			if(modelId == -1 && !customimg::ModelNameIndex::IsASCII(direntry.name))
				CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(direntry.name, &modelId);
			if(modelId >= 0){
#else
			if(CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(direntry.name, &modelId)){
#endif
				bAddToStreaming = true;
			}else{
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
				unknownModels++;
				// Auto-mounted IMGs can hold tens of thousands of DFFs without
				// IDEs, which are not script-loadable special models. Native
				// images must retain theirs; CDirectory grows when needed.
				if(!modelsOnly){
#endif
#ifdef FIX_BUGS
					ms_pExtraObjectsDir->AddItem(direntry, n);
#else
					ms_pExtraObjectsDir->AddItem(direntry);
#endif
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
				}
#endif
				lastID = -1;
			}
		}else if(strncasecmp(dot+1, "TXD", 3) == 0){
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
			// TxdDef::name[20] must hold the full stem, including NUL.
			if(dot-direntry.name > 19) {
				ignoredTypes++;
				lastID = -1;
				continue;
			}
#endif
			modelId = CTxdStore::FindTxdSlot(direntry.name);
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
			if(modelId == -1 && !(modelsOnly ? CTxdStore::HasFreeCustomSlot() : CTxdStore::HasFreeSlot())) {
				fullTxds++;
				lastID = -1;
				continue;
			}
#endif
			if(modelId == -1)
				modelId = CTxdStore::AddTxdSlot(direntry.name);
			modelId += STREAM_OFFSET_TXD;
			bAddToStreaming = true;
		}else if(strncasecmp(dot+1, "COL", 3) == 0){
			modelId = CColStore::FindColSlot(direntry.name);
			if(modelId == -1)
				modelId = CColStore::AddColSlot(direntry.name);
			modelId += STREAM_OFFSET_COL;
			bAddToStreaming = true;
		}else if(strncasecmp(dot+1, "IFP", 3) == 0){
			modelId = CAnimManager::RegisterAnimBlock(direntry.name);
			modelId += STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM;
			bAddToStreaming = true;
		}else{
			*dot = '.';
			lastID = -1;
		}

		if(bAddToStreaming){
			if(ms_aInfoForModel[modelId].GetCdSize()){
				int previous = _GET_INDEX(ms_aInfoForModel[modelId].m_position);
				const char *image = previous < CdStreamGetNumImages() ?
					CdStreamGetImageName(previous) : nil;
				debug("%s.%s appears more than once in %s; keeping %s\n",
					direntry.name, dot+1, dirname, image ? image : "unknown IMG");
				duplicates++;
				lastID = -1;
			}else{
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
				if(modelsOnly && direntry.size > (uint32)ms_streamingBufferSize)
					ms_streamingBufferSize = direntry.size;
#endif
				direntry.offset |= imgSelector;
				ms_aInfoForModel[modelId].SetCdPosnAndSize(direntry.offset, direntry.size);
				registered++;
				if(lastID != -1)
					ms_aInfoForModel[lastID].m_nextID = modelId;
				lastID = modelId;
			}
		}
	}

	CFileMgr::CloseFile(fd);
	REVC_LOG_INFO("CD directory %s (IMG %d): %d entries, %d registered, %d duplicates",
		dirname, n, entries, registered, duplicates);
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
	if(modelsOnly && (unknownModels || ignoredTypes || fullTxds))
		REVC_LOG_INFO("IMG %d: %d DFF without IDE, %d non-DFF/TXD entries bypassed by native streaming, %d TXDs over slot limit",
			n, unknownModels, ignoredTypes, fullTxds);
	if(!modelsOnly && unknownModels)
		REVC_LOG_INFO("IMG %d: %d DFF without IDE encountered; extra directory now holds %d unique models",
			n, unknownModels, ms_pExtraObjectsDir->numEntries);
	if(!modelsOnly && fullTxds)
		REVC_LOG_ERROR("IMG %d: %d native TXDs could not be registered: TXD slots exhausted", n, fullTxds);
#endif
}

static char*
GetObjectName(int streamId)
{
	static char objname[96];
	if(streamId < STREAM_OFFSET_TXD){
		CBaseModelInfo *mi = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(streamId);
		snprintf(objname, sizeof(objname), "%s.dff", (mi && mi->GetModelName()) ? mi->GetModelName() : "unknown");
	}else if(streamId >= STREAM_OFFSET_TXD && streamId < STREAM_OFFSET_COL){
		const char *tn = CTxdStore::GetTxdName(streamId-STREAM_OFFSET_TXD);
		snprintf(objname, sizeof(objname), "%s.txd", tn ? tn : "unknown");
	}else if(streamId >= STREAM_OFFSET_COL && streamId < STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM){
		const char *cn = CColStore::GetColName(streamId-STREAM_OFFSET_COL);
		snprintf(objname, sizeof(objname), "%s.col", cn ? cn : "unknown");
	}else{
		assert(streamId < NUMSTREAMINFO);
		CAnimBlock *ab = CAnimManager::GetAnimationBlock(streamId-STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM);
		snprintf(objname, sizeof(objname), "%s.ifp", ab ? ab->name : "unknown");
	}
	return objname;
}

#ifdef USE_CUSTOM_ALLOCATOR
RpAtomic*
RegisterAtomicMemPtrsCB(RpAtomic *atomic, void *data)
{
	// empty because we expect models to be pre-instanced
	return atomic;
}
#endif

bool
CStreaming::ConvertBufferToObject(int8 *buf, int32 streamId)
{
	RwMemory mem;
	RwStream *stream;
	int cdsize;
	uint32 startTime, endTime, timeDiff;
	CBaseModelInfo *mi;
	bool success;

	startTime = CTimer::GetCurrentTimeInCycles() / CTimer::GetCyclesPerMillisecond();

#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
	// The file comes from the game's custom folder, so the bytes that were
	// read from the image are not used at all: the file is decompressed and
	// converted in memory instead. Everything around the load is the same, so
	// the model ends up in exactly the state a file from the image would.
	if(CCustomModels::CanServe(streamId)){
		LoadCustomFile(streamId);
		endTime = CTimer::GetCurrentTimeInCycles() / CTimer::GetCyclesPerMillisecond();
		timeDiff = endTime - startTime;
		if(timeDiff > 5)
			debug("%s (custom) took %d ms\n", GetObjectName(streamId), timeDiff);
		return ms_aInfoForModel[streamId].m_loadState == STREAMSTATE_LOADED;
	}
#endif

	cdsize = ms_aInfoForModel[streamId].GetCdSize();
	mem.start = (uint8*)buf;
	mem.length = cdsize * CDSTREAM_SECTOR_SIZE;
	stream = RwStreamOpen(rwSTREAMMEMORY, rwSTREAMREAD, &mem);

	if(streamId < STREAM_OFFSET_TXD){
		// Model
		mi = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(streamId);

		// Txd (including any streamable txdp parent chain) and anim have to be loaded
		int animId = mi->GetAnimFileIndex();
		bool txdReady =
#ifdef FIX_BUGS
			HasTxdLoaded(mi->GetTxdSlot());
#else
			CTxdStore::GetSlot(mi->GetTxdSlot())->texDict != nil;
#endif
		if(txdReady){
			for(int p = CTxdStore::GetParentTxdSlot(mi->GetTxdSlot()), depth = 0;
			    p >= 0 && depth < 8; p = CTxdStore::GetParentTxdSlot(p), depth++){
				bool streamable = ms_aInfoForModel[p + STREAM_OFFSET_TXD].GetCdSize() > 0
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
					|| CCustomModels::CanServe(p + STREAM_OFFSET_TXD)
#endif
					;
				if(streamable && CTxdStore::GetSlot(p)->texDict == nil && !HasTxdLoaded(p)){
					RequestTxd(p, ms_aInfoForModel[streamId].m_flags & STREAMFLAGS_PRIORITY);
					txdReady = false;
				}
			}
		}
		if(!txdReady ||
		   animId != -1 && !CAnimManager::GetAnimationBlock(animId)->isLoaded){
			RemoveModel(streamId);
			ReRequestModel(streamId);
			RwStreamClose(stream, &mem);
			return false;
		}

		// Set Txd and anims to use
		CTxdStore::AddRef(mi->GetTxdSlot());
#if GTA_VERSION > GTAVC_PS2
		if(animId != -1)
			CAnimManager::AddAnimBlockRef(animId);
#endif

		PUSH_MEMID(MEMID_STREAM_MODELS);
		CTxdStore::SetCurrentTxd(mi->GetTxdSlot());
		// The IDE determines the model info type. Never treat an arbitrary DFF
		// as a ped or vehicle merely because of its filename/root-node name.
		switch(GetModelLoadKind(mi->GetModelType())){
		case MODELLOAD_ATOMIC:
			success = CFileLoader::LoadAtomicFile(stream, streamId);
			break;
		case MODELLOAD_VEHICLE:
			// Vehicles must be read in two stages.
			mi->AddRef();
			success = CFileLoader::StartLoadClumpFile(stream, streamId);
			if(success)
				ms_aInfoForModel[streamId].m_loadState = STREAMSTATE_STARTED;
			else
				mi->RemoveRef();
			break;
		case MODELLOAD_PED:
		case MODELLOAD_CLUMP:
			success = CFileLoader::LoadClumpFile(stream, streamId);
#ifdef USE_CUSTOM_ALLOCATOR
			if(success)
				RpClumpForAllAtomics((RpClump*)mi->GetRwObject(), RegisterAtomicMemPtrsCB, nil);
#endif
			break;
		default:
			REVC_LOG_WARNING("Streaming: unsupported model info type %d for %s (id %d)",
				mi->GetModelType(), mi->GetModelName(), streamId);
			success = false;
			break;
		}
		POP_MEMID();
		UpdateMemoryUsed();

		// Txd and anims no longer needed unless we only read part of the file
		if(ms_aInfoForModel[streamId].m_loadState != STREAMSTATE_STARTED){
			CTxdStore::RemoveRefWithoutDelete(mi->GetTxdSlot());
#if GTA_VERSION > GTAVC_PS2
			if(animId != -1)
				CAnimManager::RemoveAnimBlockRefWithoutDelete(animId);
#endif
		}

		if(!success){
			CBaseModelInfo *failedInfo = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(streamId);
			debug("Failed to load %s\n", failedInfo ? failedInfo->GetModelName() : "unknown");
			RemoveModel(streamId);
			ReRequestModel(streamId);
			RwStreamClose(stream, &mem);
			return false;
		}
	}else if(streamId >= STREAM_OFFSET_TXD && streamId < STREAM_OFFSET_COL){
		// Txd
		if((ms_aInfoForModel[streamId].m_flags & STREAMFLAGS_KEEP_IN_MEMORY) == 0 &&
		   !IsTxdUsedByRequestedModels(streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_TXD)){
			RemoveModel(streamId);
			RwStreamClose(stream, &mem);
			return false;
		}

		PUSH_MEMID(MEMID_STREAM_TEXUTRES);
		if(ms_bLoadingBigModel || cdsize > 200){
			success = CTxdStore::StartLoadTxd(streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_TXD, stream);
			if(success)
				ms_aInfoForModel[streamId].m_loadState = STREAMSTATE_STARTED;
		}else
		        success = CTxdStore::LoadTxd(streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_TXD, stream);
		POP_MEMID();
		UpdateMemoryUsed();

		if(!success){
			uint32 pos = ms_aInfoForModel[streamId].m_position;
			int imageIndex = _GET_INDEX(pos);
			const char *image = imageIndex < CdStreamGetNumImages() ?
				CdStreamGetImageName(imageIndex) : nil;
			const uint8 *header = (const uint8*)buf;
			REVC_LOG_ERROR("Failed to load %s.txd from %s (sector=%u, sectors=%d, header=%02X %02X %02X %02X)",
				CTxdStore::GetTxdName(streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_TXD),
				image ? image : "unknown IMG", _GET_OFFSET(pos), cdsize,
				(unsigned)header[0], (unsigned)header[1], (unsigned)header[2], (unsigned)header[3]);
			RemoveModel(streamId);
			ReRequestModel(streamId);
			RwStreamClose(stream, &mem);
			return false;
		}
	}else if(streamId >= STREAM_OFFSET_COL && streamId < STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM){
		PUSH_MEMID(MEMID_STREAM_COLLISION);
		bool success = CColStore::LoadCol(streamId-STREAM_OFFSET_COL, mem.start, mem.length);
		POP_MEMID();
		if(!success){
			debug("Failed to load %s.col\n", CColStore::GetColName(streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_COL));
			RemoveModel(streamId);
			ReRequestModel(streamId);
			RwStreamClose(stream, &mem);
			return false;
		}
	}else if(streamId >= STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM){
		assert(streamId < NUMSTREAMINFO);
		if((ms_aInfoForModel[streamId].m_flags & STREAMFLAGS_KEEP_IN_MEMORY) == 0 &&
		   !AreAnimsUsedByRequestedModels(streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM)){
			RemoveModel(streamId);
			RwStreamClose(stream, &mem);
			return false;
		}
		PUSH_MEMID(MEMID_STREAM_ANIMATION);
		// The ped animation set is SA only, so a streamed animation block is
		// mapped onto its "sa_" dictionary instead of filling a VC one. The
		// custom bank is preferred and the streamed data is the fallback.
		{
			CAnimBlock *nativeBlock = CAnimManager::GetAnimationBlock(streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM);
			char blockName[MAX_ANIMBLOCK_NAME];
			blockName[0] = '\0';
			if(nativeBlock && nativeBlock->name[0])
				CAnimManager::MakeSAAnimBlockName(nativeBlock->name, blockName, sizeof(blockName));
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
			if(blockName[0]){
				char customAnimFile[64];
				snprintf(customAnimFile, sizeof(customAnimFile), "ANIM\\%s.IFP", nativeBlock->name);
				CAnimManager::LoadSAAnimFileFromCustom(customAnimFile);
			}
#endif
			// Never pour the streamed Vice City dictionary into the SA block:
			// its clips are the old set, and mixing them in is what used to
			// make a ped fall back to a VC animation once a block was paged
			// in mid-game. An SA bank only ever comes from the custom archives.
			CAnimBlock *saBlock = blockName[0] ? CAnimManager::GetAnimationBlock(blockName) : nil;
			if(saBlock == nil || !saBlock->isLoaded){
				POP_MEMID();
				RwStreamClose(stream, &mem);
				return false;
			}
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
			CUSTOM_LOG("stream animation %d: SA block %s ready; building groups\n",
				streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM, blockName[0] ? blockName : "(unnamed)");
#endif
		}
		CAnimManager::CreateAnimAssocGroups();
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
		CUSTOM_LOG("stream animation %d: groups returned\n", streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM);
#endif
		POP_MEMID();
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
		CUSTOM_LOG("stream animation %d: memory scope popped\n", streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM);
#endif
	}

	RwStreamClose(stream, &mem);
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
	if(streamId >= STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM)
		CUSTOM_LOG("stream animation %d: stream closed\n", streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM);
#endif

	if(streamId < STREAM_OFFSET_TXD){
		// Model
		// Vehicles and Peds not in loaded list
		if (mi->GetModelType() != MITYPE_VEHICLE && mi->GetModelType() != MITYPE_PED) {
			CSimpleModelInfo *smi = (CSimpleModelInfo*)mi;

			// Set fading for some objects
			if(mi->IsSimple() && !smi->m_isBigBuilding){
				if(ms_aInfoForModel[streamId].m_flags & STREAMFLAGS_NOFADE)
					smi->m_alpha = 255;
				else
					smi->m_alpha = 0;
			}

			if(CanRemoveModel(streamId))
				ms_aInfoForModel[streamId].AddToList(&ms_startLoadedList);
		}
	}else if(streamId >= STREAM_OFFSET_TXD && streamId < STREAM_OFFSET_COL ||
	         streamId >= STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM){
		assert(streamId < NUMSTREAMINFO);
		// Txd and anims
		if(CanRemoveModel(streamId))
			ms_aInfoForModel[streamId].AddToList(&ms_startLoadedList);
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
		if(streamId >= STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM)
			CUSTOM_LOG("stream animation %d: loaded-list update complete\n", streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM);
#endif
	}

	// Mark objects as loaded
	if(ms_aInfoForModel[streamId].m_loadState != STREAMSTATE_STARTED){
		ms_aInfoForModel[streamId].m_loadState = STREAMSTATE_LOADED;
#ifndef USE_CUSTOM_ALLOCATOR
		ms_memoryUsed += ms_aInfoForModel[streamId].GetCdSize() * CDSTREAM_SECTOR_SIZE;
#endif
	}
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
	if(streamId >= STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM)
		CUSTOM_LOG("stream animation %d: load state committed\n", streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM);
#endif

	endTime = CTimer::GetCurrentTimeInCycles() / CTimer::GetCyclesPerMillisecond();
	timeDiff = endTime - startTime;
	if(timeDiff > 5)
		debug("%s took %d ms\n", GetObjectName(streamId), timeDiff);
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
	if(streamId >= STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM)
		CUSTOM_LOG("stream animation %d: load routine returning\n", streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM);
#endif

	return true;
}

bool
CStreaming::FinishLoadingLargeFile(int8 *buf, int32 streamId)
{
	RwMemory mem;
	RwStream *stream;
	uint32 startTime, endTime, timeDiff;
	CBaseModelInfo *mi;
	bool success;

	startTime = CTimer::GetCurrentTimeInCycles() / CTimer::GetCyclesPerMillisecond();

	if(ms_aInfoForModel[streamId].m_loadState != STREAMSTATE_STARTED){
		if(streamId < STREAM_OFFSET_TXD){
			CBaseModelInfo *aborted = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(streamId);
			if(aborted)
				aborted->RemoveRef();
		}
		return false;
	}

	mem.start = (uint8*)buf;
	mem.length = ms_aInfoForModel[streamId].GetCdSize() * CDSTREAM_SECTOR_SIZE;
	stream = RwStreamOpen(rwSTREAMMEMORY, rwSTREAMREAD, &mem);

	if(streamId < STREAM_OFFSET_TXD){
		// Model
		mi = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(streamId);
		PUSH_MEMID(MEMID_STREAM_MODELS);
		CTxdStore::SetCurrentTxd(mi->GetTxdSlot());
		success = CFileLoader::FinishLoadClumpFile(stream, streamId);
		if(success){
#ifdef USE_CUSTOM_ALLOCATOR
			RpClumpForAllAtomics((RpClump*)mi->GetRwObject(), RegisterAtomicMemPtrsCB, nil);
#endif
			success = AddToLoadedVehiclesList(streamId);
		}
		POP_MEMID();
		mi->RemoveRef();
		CTxdStore::RemoveRefWithoutDelete(mi->GetTxdSlot());
#if GTA_VERSION > GTAVC_PS2
		if(mi->GetAnimFileIndex() != -1)
			CAnimManager::RemoveAnimBlockRefWithoutDelete(mi->GetAnimFileIndex());
#endif
	}else if(streamId >= STREAM_OFFSET_TXD && streamId < STREAM_OFFSET_COL){
		// Txd
		CTxdStore::AddRef(streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_TXD);
		PUSH_MEMID(MEMID_STREAM_TEXUTRES);
		success = CTxdStore::FinishLoadTxd(streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_TXD, stream);
		POP_MEMID();
		CTxdStore::RemoveRefWithoutDelete(streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_TXD);
	}else{
		assert(0 && "invalid streamId");
	}

	RwStreamClose(stream, &mem);

	ms_aInfoForModel[streamId].m_loadState = STREAMSTATE_LOADED;
#ifndef USE_CUSTOM_ALLOCATOR
	ms_memoryUsed += ms_aInfoForModel[streamId].GetCdSize() * CDSTREAM_SECTOR_SIZE;
#endif

	if(!success){
		RemoveModel(streamId);
		ReRequestModel(streamId);
		UpdateMemoryUsed();
		return false;
	}

	UpdateMemoryUsed();

	endTime = CTimer::GetCurrentTimeInCycles() / CTimer::GetCyclesPerMillisecond();
	timeDiff = endTime - startTime;
	if(timeDiff > 5)
		debug("%s took %d ms\n", GetObjectName(streamId), timeDiff);

	return true;
}

void
CStreaming::RequestModel(int32 id, int32 flags)
{
	CSimpleModelInfo *mi;

	// A request may name a model nobody registered: the native VC IDEs are no
	// longer read, so built-in ids such as MI_POLICE have no model info while
	// the engine still starts traffic and wanted-level preloads. Queueing such
	// an id would dereference nil below (mi->GetTxdSlot).
	if(id < 0 || id >= NUMSTREAMINFO)
		return;
	if(id < STREAM_OFFSET_TXD && CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(id) == nil)
		return;

	if(id >= STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM && id < NUMSTREAMINFO){
		CAnimBlock *animBlock = CAnimManager::GetAnimationBlock(id - STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM);
		if(animBlock)
			animBlock->unloadPending = false;
	}

	if(ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_loadState == STREAMSTATE_INQUEUE){
		// updgrade to priority
		if(flags & STREAMFLAGS_PRIORITY && !ms_aInfoForModel[id].IsPriority()){
			ms_numPriorityRequests++;
			ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_flags |= STREAMFLAGS_PRIORITY;
		}
	}else if(ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_loadState != STREAMSTATE_NOTLOADED){
		flags &= ~STREAMFLAGS_PRIORITY;
	}
	ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_flags |= flags;

	if(ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_loadState == STREAMSTATE_LOADED){
		// Already loaded, only check changed flags

		if(ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_flags & STREAMFLAGS_NOFADE && id < STREAM_OFFSET_TXD){
			mi = (CSimpleModelInfo*)CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(id);
			if(mi->IsSimple())
				mi->m_alpha = 255;
		}

		// reinsert into list
		if(ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_next){
			ms_aInfoForModel[id].RemoveFromList();
			if(CanRemoveModel(id))
				ms_aInfoForModel[id].AddToList(&ms_startLoadedList);
		}
	}else if(ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_loadState == STREAMSTATE_NOTLOADED ||
	         ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_loadState == STREAMSTATE_LOADED){	// how can this be true again?

		if(ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_loadState == STREAMSTATE_NOTLOADED){
			if(id < STREAM_OFFSET_TXD){
				mi = (CSimpleModelInfo*)CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(id);
				RequestTxd(mi->GetTxdSlot(), flags);
				for(int p = CTxdStore::GetParentTxdSlot(mi->GetTxdSlot()), depth = 0;
				    p >= 0 && depth < 8; p = CTxdStore::GetParentTxdSlot(p), depth++){
					bool streamable = ms_aInfoForModel[p + STREAM_OFFSET_TXD].GetCdSize() > 0
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
						|| CCustomModels::CanServe(p + STREAM_OFFSET_TXD)
#endif
						;
					if(streamable)
						RequestTxd(p, flags & STREAMFLAGS_PRIORITY);
				}
				int anim = mi->GetAnimFileIndex();
				if(anim != -1)
					RequestAnim(anim, STREAMFLAGS_DEPENDENCY);
			}
			ms_aInfoForModel[id].AddToList(&ms_startRequestedList);
			ms_numModelsRequested++;
			if(flags & STREAMFLAGS_PRIORITY)
				ms_numPriorityRequests++;
		}

		ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_loadState = STREAMSTATE_INQUEUE;
		ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_flags = flags;
	}
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
	if(ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_loadState == STREAMSTATE_INQUEUE)
		CCustomModels::PrefetchStream(id, ms_aInfoForModel[id].IsPriority());
#endif
}

#define BIGBUILDINGFLAGS STREAMFLAGS_DONT_REMOVE

void
CStreaming::RequestBigBuildings(eLevelName level)
{
	int i, n;
	CBuilding *b;

	n = CPools::GetBuildingPool()->GetSize()-1;
	for(i = n; i >= 0; i--){
		b = CPools::GetBuildingPool()->GetSlot(i);
		if(b && b->bIsBIGBuilding
#ifdef NO_ISLAND_LOADING
		   && (((FrontEndMenuManager.m_PrefsIslandLoading != CMenuManager::ISLAND_LOADING_LOW) && (b != pIslandLODmainlandEntity) &&
		        (b != pIslandLODbeachEntity)) ||
		       (b->m_level == level))
#else
		   && b->m_level == level
#endif
			)
			if(!b->bStreamBIGBuilding)
				RequestModel(b->GetModelIndex(), BIGBUILDINGFLAGS);
	}
	RequestIslands(level);
}

void
CStreaming::RequestBigBuildings(eLevelName level, const CVector &pos)
{
	int i, n;
	CBuilding *b;

	n = CPools::GetBuildingPool()->GetSize()-1;
	for(i = n; i >= 0; i--){
		b = CPools::GetBuildingPool()->GetSlot(i);
		if(b && b->bIsBIGBuilding
#ifdef NO_ISLAND_LOADING
		    && (((FrontEndMenuManager.m_PrefsIslandLoading != CMenuManager::ISLAND_LOADING_LOW) && (b != pIslandLODmainlandEntity) && (b != pIslandLODbeachEntity)
				) || (b->m_level == level))
#else
		   && b->m_level == level
#endif
		)
			if(b->bStreamBIGBuilding){
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
				if(CCustomWorld::OwnsModelSlot(b->GetModelIndex()) &&
				   (b->GetPosition() - pos).MagnitudeSqr() > sq(420.0f))
					continue;
#endif
				if(CRenderer::ShouldModelBeStreamed(b, pos))
					RequestModel(b->GetModelIndex(), 0);
			}else
				RequestModel(b->GetModelIndex(), BIGBUILDINGFLAGS);
	}
	RequestIslands(level);
}

void
CStreaming::InstanceBigBuildings(eLevelName level, const CVector &pos)
{
	int i, n;
	CBuilding *b;

	n = CPools::GetBuildingPool()->GetSize()-1;
	for(i = n; i >= 0; i--){
		b = CPools::GetBuildingPool()->GetSlot(i);
		if(b && b->bIsBIGBuilding && b->m_level == level &&
		   b->bStreamBIGBuilding && b->m_rwObject == nil)
			if(CRenderer::ShouldModelBeStreamed(b, pos))
				b->CreateRwObject();
	}
}

void
CStreaming::InstanceLoadedModelsInSectorList(CPtrList &list)
{
	CPtrNode *node;
	CEntity *e;
	for(node = list.first; node; node = node->next) {
		e = (CEntity *)node->item;
		if(IsAreaVisible(e->m_area) && e->m_rwObject == nil)
			e->CreateRwObject();
	}
}

void
CStreaming::InstanceLoadedModels(const CVector &pos)
{
	int minX = CWorld::GetSectorIndexX(pos.x - 80.0f);

	int minY = CWorld::GetSectorIndexY(pos.y - 80.0f);

	int maxX = CWorld::GetSectorIndexX(pos.x + 80.0f);

	int maxY = CWorld::GetSectorIndexY(pos.y + 80.0f);

	int x, y;
	for(y = minY; y <= maxY; y++){
		for(x = minX; x <= maxX; x++){
			CSector *sector = CWorld::GetSector(x, y);
			InstanceLoadedModelsInSectorList(sector->m_lists[ENTITYLIST_BUILDINGS]);
			InstanceLoadedModelsInSectorList(sector->m_lists[ENTITYLIST_BUILDINGS_OVERLAP]);
			InstanceLoadedModelsInSectorList(sector->m_lists[ENTITYLIST_OBJECTS]);
			InstanceLoadedModelsInSectorList(sector->m_lists[ENTITYLIST_DUMMIES]);
		}
	}
}

void
CStreaming::RequestIslands(eLevelName level)
{
	ISLAND_LOADING_ISNT(HIGH)
	switch(level){
	case LEVEL_MAINLAND:
		if(islandLODbeach != -1)
			RequestModel(islandLODbeach, BIGBUILDINGFLAGS);
		break;
	case LEVEL_BEACH:
		if(islandLODmainland != -1)
			RequestModel(islandLODmainland, BIGBUILDINGFLAGS);
		break;
	default: break;
	}
}

// SA CStreaming::RequestVehicleUpgrade (0x408C70).
void
CStreaming::RequestVehicleUpgrade(int32 modelId, int32 streamingFlags)
{
	RequestModel(modelId, streamingFlags);
	int16 other = CVehicleModelInfo::ms_linkedUpgrades.FindOtherUpgrade((int16)modelId);
	if(other != -1)
		RequestModel(other, streamingFlags);
}

// SA CStreaming::HasVehicleUpgradeLoaded (0x407820).
bool
CStreaming::HasVehicleUpgradeLoaded(int32 modelId)
{
	if(!HasModelLoaded(modelId))
		return false;
	int16 other = CVehicleModelInfo::ms_linkedUpgrades.FindOtherUpgrade((int16)modelId);
	return other == -1 || HasModelLoaded(other);
}

void
CStreaming::RequestSpecialModel(int32 modelId, const char *modelName, int32 flags)
{
	CBaseModelInfo *mi;
	int txdId;
	char oldName[48];
	uint32 pos, size;
	int i, n;

	mi = modelId >= 0 && modelId < MODELINFOSIZE ? CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(modelId) : nil;
	if(mi == nil || modelName == nil || modelName[0] == '\0'){
		CUSTOM_LOG("special model: invalid model id=%d or empty name; request ignored\n", modelId);
		return;
	}
	if(strncasecmp("CSPlay", modelName, 6) == 0){
		CBaseModelInfo *player = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(MI_PLAYER);
		const char *curname = player ? player->GetModelName() : "";
		for(int i = 0; CSnames[i][0]; i++){
			if(strcasecmp(curname, IGnames[i]) == 0){
				modelName = CSnames[i];
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	// Reject nonterminated/corrupt names before comparing them or copying
	// into CBaseModelInfo::m_name. SCM keys are fixed-width, not C strings.
	size_t nameLen = 0;
	while(nameLen < MAX_MODEL_NAME && modelName[nameLen]) nameLen++;
	if(nameLen == MAX_MODEL_NAME){
		CUSTOM_LOG("special model id=%d: name exceeds %d bytes; request ignored\n",
			modelId, MAX_MODEL_NAME-1);
		return;
	}
	if(!CGeneral::faststrcmp(mi->GetModelName(), modelName)){
		// Already have the correct name, just request it
		RequestModel(modelId, flags);
		return;
	}

	// Ordinary IDE DFFs are not kept in ms_pExtraObjectsDir; user IMGs also
	// omit their orphan DFFs from that directory. Both are valid script
	// special models, so consult the pre-indexed DIR metadata before changing
	// the slot name, unloading its old model or deleting referencing peds.
	bool found = false;
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
	found = CCustomModels::FindModelDffInImage(modelName, pos, size);
#endif
	if(!found) found = ms_pExtraObjectsDir->FindItem(modelName, pos, size);
	if(found && (size == 0 || _GET_INDEX(pos) >= CdStreamGetNumImages())){
		CUSTOM_LOG("special model id=%d name=%s: invalid IMG record index=%u, sectors=%u; keeping old model\n",
			modelId, modelName, (unsigned)_GET_INDEX(pos), (unsigned)size);
		return;
	}
	if(!found){
		CUSTOM_LOG("special model id=%d name=%s (old=%s): no DFF in mounted IMG; keeping old model\n",
			modelId, modelName, mi->GetModelName());
		return;
	}
	CUSTOM_LOG("special model id=%d name=%s (old=%s): source=mounted IMG %s\n",
		modelId, modelName, mi->GetModelName(), CdStreamGetImageName(_GET_INDEX(pos)));

	if(mi->GetNumRefs() > 0){
		n = CPools::GetPedPool()->GetSize()-1;
		for(i = n; i >= 0 && mi->GetNumRefs() > 0; i--){
			CPed *ped = CPools::GetPedPool()->GetSlot(i);
			if(ped && ped->GetModelIndex() == modelId &&
			   !ped->IsPlayer() && ped->CanBeDeletedEvenInVehicle())
				CTheScripts::RemoveThisPed(ped);
		}
		n = CPools::GetObjectPool()->GetSize()-1;
		for(i = n; i >= 0 && mi->GetNumRefs() > 0; i--){
			CObject *obj = CPools::GetObjectPool()->GetSlot(i);
			if(obj && obj->GetModelIndex() == modelId && obj->CanBeDeleted()){
				CWorld::Remove(obj);
				CWorld::RemoveReferencesToDeletedObject(obj);
				delete obj;
			}
		}
	}

	strcpy(oldName, mi->GetModelName());
	mi->SetModelName(modelName);

	// What exactly is going on here?
	if(CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(oldName, nil)){
		txdId = CTxdStore::FindTxdSlot(oldName);
		if(txdId != -1 && CTxdStore::GetSlot(txdId)->texDict){
			CTxdStore::AddRef(txdId);
			RemoveModel(modelId);
			CTxdStore::RemoveRefWithoutDelete(txdId);
		}else
			RemoveModel(modelId);
	}else
		RemoveModel(modelId);

	mi->ClearTexDictionary();
	if(CTxdStore::FindTxdSlot(modelName) == -1)
		mi->SetTexDictionary("generic");
	else
		mi->SetTexDictionary(modelName);
	ms_aInfoForModel[modelId].SetCdPosnAndSize(pos, size);
	RequestModel(modelId, flags);
}

void
CStreaming::RequestSpecialChar(int32 charId, const char *modelName, int32 flags)
{
	RequestSpecialModel(charId + MI_SPECIAL01, modelName, flags);
}

bool
CStreaming::HasSpecialCharLoaded(int32 id)
{
	return HasModelLoaded(id + MI_SPECIAL01);
}

void
CStreaming::SetMissionDoesntRequireSpecialChar(int32 id)
{
	return SetMissionDoesntRequireModel(id + MI_SPECIAL01);
}

void
CStreaming::DecrementRef(int32 id)
{
	ms_numModelsRequested--;
	if(ms_aInfoForModel[id].IsPriority()){
		ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_flags &= ~STREAMFLAGS_PRIORITY;
		ms_numPriorityRequests--;
	}
}

void
CStreaming::RemoveModel(int32 id)
{
	int i;

	// An active animation association owns a block reference. Do not let an
	// explicit removal or memory-pressure path invalidate its hierarchy.
	if(id >= STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM && id < NUMSTREAMINFO &&
	   CAnimManager::GetNumRefsToAnimBlock(id - STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM) > 0){
		CAnimManager::GetAnimationBlock(id - STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM)->unloadPending = true;
		debug("Keeping animation block %d loaded while associations reference it\n", id - STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM);
		return;
	}

	if(ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_loadState == STREAMSTATE_NOTLOADED)
		return;

#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
	CCustomModels::CancelStreamPrefetch(id);
#endif
	if(ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_loadState == STREAMSTATE_LOADED){
		if(id < STREAM_OFFSET_TXD){
			CBaseModelInfo *loadedInfo = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(id);
			if(loadedInfo)
				loadedInfo->DeleteRwObject();
		}
		else if(id >= STREAM_OFFSET_TXD && id < STREAM_OFFSET_COL){
#ifdef CUSTOM_MODELS
			// Custom TXDs are already GPU-ready. Keep a bounded number of
			// evicted dictionaries instead of decoding and uploading them again.
			if(!CCustomModels::RetainTxdOnUnload(id - STREAM_OFFSET_TXD))
#endif
				CTxdStore::RemoveTxd(id - STREAM_OFFSET_TXD);
		}else if(id >= STREAM_OFFSET_COL && id < STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM)
			CColStore::RemoveCol(id - STREAM_OFFSET_COL);
		else if(id >= STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM){
			assert(id < NUMSTREAMINFO);
			CAnimManager::RemoveAnimBlock(id - STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM);
		}
		ms_memoryUsed -= ms_aInfoForModel[id].GetCdSize()*CDSTREAM_SECTOR_SIZE;
	}

	if(ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_next){
		// Remove from list, model is neither loaded nor requested
		if(ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_loadState == STREAMSTATE_INQUEUE)
			DecrementRef(id);
		ms_aInfoForModel[id].RemoveFromList();
	}else if(ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_loadState == STREAMSTATE_READING){
		for(i = 0; i < 4; i++){
			if(ms_channel[0].streamIds[i] == id)
				ms_channel[0].streamIds[i] = -1;
			if(ms_channel[1].streamIds[i] == id)
				ms_channel[1].streamIds[i] = -1;
		}
	}

	if(ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_loadState == STREAMSTATE_STARTED){
		if(id < STREAM_OFFSET_TXD)
			RpClumpGtaCancelStream();
		else if(id >= STREAM_OFFSET_TXD && id < STREAM_OFFSET_COL)
			CTxdStore::RemoveTxd(id - STREAM_OFFSET_TXD);
		else if(id >= STREAM_OFFSET_COL && id < STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM)
			CColStore::RemoveCol(id - STREAM_OFFSET_COL);
		else if(id >= STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM){
			assert(id < NUMSTREAMINFO);
			CAnimManager::RemoveAnimBlock(id - STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM);
		}
	}

	ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_loadState = STREAMSTATE_NOTLOADED;
}

void
CStreaming::RemoveUnusedBuildings(eLevelName level)
{
	if(level != LEVEL_BEACH)
		RemoveBuildings(LEVEL_BEACH);
	if(level != LEVEL_MAINLAND)
		RemoveBuildings(LEVEL_MAINLAND);
}

void
CStreaming::RemoveBuildings(eLevelName level)
{
	int i, n;
	CEntity *e;
	CBaseModelInfo *mi;

	n = CPools::GetBuildingPool()->GetSize()-1;
	for(i = n; i >= 0; i--){
		e = CPools::GetBuildingPool()->GetSlot(i);
		if(e && e->m_level == level){
			mi = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(e->GetModelIndex());
			if(!e->bImBeingRendered){
				e->DeleteRwObject();
				if (mi->GetNumRefs() == 0)
					RemoveModel(e->GetModelIndex());
			}
		}
	}

	n = CPools::GetTreadablePool()->GetSize()-1;
	for(i = n; i >= 0; i--){
		e = CPools::GetTreadablePool()->GetSlot(i);
		if(e && e->m_level == level){
			mi = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(e->GetModelIndex());
			if(!e->bImBeingRendered){
				e->DeleteRwObject();
				if (mi->GetNumRefs() == 0)
					RemoveModel(e->GetModelIndex());
			}
		}
	}

	n = CPools::GetObjectPool()->GetSize()-1;
	for(i = n; i >= 0; i--){
		e = CPools::GetObjectPool()->GetSlot(i);
		if(e && e->m_level == level){
			mi = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(e->GetModelIndex());
			if(!e->bImBeingRendered && ((CObject*)e)->ObjectCreatedBy == GAME_OBJECT){
				e->DeleteRwObject();
				if (mi->GetNumRefs() == 0)
					RemoveModel(e->GetModelIndex());
			}
		}
	}

	n = CPools::GetDummyPool()->GetSize()-1;
	for(i = n; i >= 0; i--){
		e = CPools::GetDummyPool()->GetSlot(i);
		if(e && e->m_level == level){
			mi = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(e->GetModelIndex());
			if(!e->bImBeingRendered){
				e->DeleteRwObject();
				if (mi->GetNumRefs() == 0)
					RemoveModel(e->GetModelIndex());
			}
		}
	}
}

void
CStreaming::RemoveBuildingsNotInArea(int32 area)
{
	int i, n;
	CEntity *e;

	n = CPools::GetBuildingPool()->GetSize()-1;
	for(i = n; i >= 0; i--){
		e = CPools::GetBuildingPool()->GetSlot(i);
		if(e && e->m_rwObject && !IsAreaVisible(area) &&
		   (!e->bIsBIGBuilding || e->bStreamBIGBuilding)){
			if(e->bIsBIGBuilding)
				RequestModel(e->GetModelIndex(), 0);
			if(!e->bImBeingRendered)
				e->DeleteRwObject();
		}
	}

	n = CPools::GetTreadablePool()->GetSize()-1;
	for(i = n; i >= 0; i--){
		e = CPools::GetTreadablePool()->GetSlot(i);
		if(e && e->m_rwObject && !IsAreaVisible(area) &&
		   (!e->bIsBIGBuilding || e->bStreamBIGBuilding)){
			if(e->bIsBIGBuilding)
				RequestModel(e->GetModelIndex(), 0);
			if(!e->bImBeingRendered)
				e->DeleteRwObject();
		}
	}

	n = CPools::GetObjectPool()->GetSize()-1;
	for(i = n; i >= 0; i--){
		e = CPools::GetObjectPool()->GetSlot(i);
		if(e && e->m_rwObject && !IsAreaVisible(area) &&
		   (!e->bIsBIGBuilding || e->bStreamBIGBuilding)){
			if(e->bIsBIGBuilding)
				RequestModel(e->GetModelIndex(), 0);
			if(!e->bImBeingRendered)
				e->DeleteRwObject();
		}
	}

	n = CPools::GetDummyPool()->GetSize()-1;
	for(i = n; i >= 0; i--){
		e = CPools::GetDummyPool()->GetSlot(i);
		if(e && e->m_rwObject && !IsAreaVisible(area) &&
		   (!e->bIsBIGBuilding || e->bStreamBIGBuilding)){
			if(e->bIsBIGBuilding)
				RequestModel(e->GetModelIndex(), 0);
			if(!e->bImBeingRendered)
				e->DeleteRwObject();
		}
	}
}

void
CStreaming::RemoveUnusedBigBuildings(eLevelName level)
{
	ISLAND_LOADING_IS(LOW)
	{
	if(level != LEVEL_BEACH)
		RemoveBigBuildings(LEVEL_BEACH);
	if(level != LEVEL_MAINLAND)
		RemoveBigBuildings(LEVEL_MAINLAND);
	}
	RemoveIslandsNotUsed(level);
}

void
DeleteIsland(CEntity *island)
{
	if(island == nil)
		return;
	if(island->bImBeingRendered)
		debug("Didn't delete island because it was being rendered\n");
	else{
		island->DeleteRwObject();
		CStreaming::RemoveModel(island->GetModelIndex());
	}
}

void
CStreaming::RemoveIslandsNotUsed(eLevelName level)
{
	int i;
	if(pIslandLODmainlandEntity == nil)
	for(i = CPools::GetBuildingPool()->GetSize()-1; i >= 0; i--){
		CBuilding *building = CPools::GetBuildingPool()->GetSlot(i);
		if(building == nil)
			continue;
		if(building->GetModelIndex() == islandLODmainland)
			pIslandLODmainlandEntity = building;
		if(building->GetModelIndex() == islandLODbeach)
			pIslandLODbeachEntity = building;
	}
#ifdef NO_ISLAND_LOADING
	if(FrontEndMenuManager.m_PrefsIslandLoading == CMenuManager::ISLAND_LOADING_HIGH) {
		DeleteIsland(pIslandLODmainlandEntity);
		DeleteIsland(pIslandLODbeachEntity);
	} else
#endif
	switch(level){
	case LEVEL_MAINLAND:
		DeleteIsland(pIslandLODmainlandEntity);
		break;
	case LEVEL_BEACH:
		DeleteIsland(pIslandLODbeachEntity);

		break;
	}
}

void
CStreaming::RemoveBigBuildings(eLevelName level)
{
	int i, n;
	CEntity *e;
	CBaseModelInfo *mi;

	n = CPools::GetBuildingPool()->GetSize()-1;
	for(i = n; i >= 0; i--){
		e = CPools::GetBuildingPool()->GetSlot(i);
		if(e && e->bIsBIGBuilding && e->m_level == level){
			mi = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(e->GetModelIndex());
			if(!e->bImBeingRendered){
				e->DeleteRwObject();
				if (mi->GetNumRefs() == 0)
					RemoveModel(e->GetModelIndex());
			}
		}
	}
}

bool
CStreaming::RemoveLoadedVehicle(void)
{
	int i, id;

	for(i = 0; i < MAXVEHICLESLOADED; i++){
		ms_lastVehicleDeleted++;
		if(ms_lastVehicleDeleted == MAXVEHICLESLOADED)
			ms_lastVehicleDeleted = 0;
		id = ms_vehiclesLoaded[ms_lastVehicleDeleted];
		if(id != -1 && CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(id) != nil && CanRemoveModel(id) &&
		   CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(id)->GetNumRefs() == 0 &&
		   ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_loadState == STREAMSTATE_LOADED)
			goto found;
	}
	return false;
found:
	RemoveModel(ms_vehiclesLoaded[ms_lastVehicleDeleted]);
	ms_numVehiclesLoaded--;
	ms_vehiclesLoaded[ms_lastVehicleDeleted] = -1;
	CVehicleModelInfo* pVehicleInfo = (CVehicleModelInfo*)CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(id);
	if (pVehicleInfo->m_vehicleClass != -1)
		CCarCtrl::RemoveFromLoadedVehicleArray(id, pVehicleInfo->m_vehicleClass);
	return true;
}

bool
CStreaming::RemoveLeastUsedModel(uint32 excludeMask)
{
	CStreamingInfo *si;
	int streamId;

	for(si = ms_endLoadedList.m_prev; si != &ms_startLoadedList; si = si->m_prev){
		if(si->m_flags & excludeMask)
			continue;
		streamId = si - ms_aInfoForModel;
		if(streamId < STREAM_OFFSET_TXD){
			CBaseModelInfo *loadedInfo = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(streamId);
			if (loadedInfo == nil || loadedInfo->GetNumRefs() == 0) {
				RemoveModel(streamId);
				return true;
			}
		}else if(streamId >= STREAM_OFFSET_TXD && streamId < STREAM_OFFSET_COL){
			if(CTxdStore::GetNumRefs(streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_TXD) == 0 &&
			   !IsTxdUsedByRequestedModels(streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_TXD)){
				RemoveModel(streamId);
				return true;
			}
		}else if(streamId >= STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM){
			assert(streamId < NUMSTREAMINFO);
			if(CAnimManager::GetNumRefsToAnimBlock(streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM) == 0 &&
			   !AreAnimsUsedByRequestedModels(streamId - STREAM_OFFSET_ANIM)){
				RemoveModel(streamId);
				return true;
			}
		}
	}
	return (ms_numVehiclesLoaded > 7 || CGame::currArea != AREA_MAIN_MAP && ms_numVehiclesLoaded > 4) && RemoveLoadedVehicle();
}

void
CStreaming::RemoveAllUnusedModels(void)
{
	int i;

	for(i = 0; i < MAXVEHICLESLOADED; i++)
		RemoveLoadedVehicle();

	for(i = NUM_DEFAULT_MODELS; i < MODELINFOSIZE; i++){
		if(ms_aInfoForModel[i].m_loadState == STREAMSTATE_LOADED &&
		    CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(i) != nil &&
		    CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(i)->GetNumRefs() == 0) {
			RemoveModel(i);
			ms_aInfoForModel[i].m_loadState = STREAMSTATE_NOTLOADED;
		}
	}
}

void
CStreaming::RemoveUnusedModelsInLoadedList(void)
{
	// empty
}

bool
CStreaming::RemoveLoadedZoneModel(void)
{
	int i;

	if(ms_currentPedGrp == -1)
		return false;

	for(i = 0; i < NUMMODELSPERPEDGROUP; i++){
		int mi = CPopulation::ms_pPedGroups[ms_currentPedGrp].models[i];
		if(mi != -1 && CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(mi) != nil &&
		   ms_bIsPedFromPedGroupLoaded[i] &&
		   HasModelLoaded(mi) &&  CanRemoveModel(mi) &&
		   CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(mi)->GetNumRefs() == 0){
			RemoveModel(CPopulation::ms_pPedGroups[ms_currentPedGrp].models[i]);
			ms_numPedsLoaded--;
			ms_bIsPedFromPedGroupLoaded[i] = false;
			return true;
		}
	}

	return false;
}

static bool
DoesModelUseTxdInHierarchy(int32 modelStreamId, int32 txdId)
{
	if(modelStreamId < 0 || modelStreamId >= STREAM_OFFSET_TXD)
		return false;
	CBaseModelInfo *mi = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(modelStreamId);
	if(mi == nil)
		return false;
	for(int cur = mi->GetTxdSlot(), depth = 0; cur >= 0 && depth < 8;
	    cur = CTxdStore::GetParentTxdSlot(cur), depth++){
		if(cur == txdId)
			return true;
	}
	return false;
}

bool
CStreaming::IsTxdUsedByRequestedModels(int32 txdId)
{
	CStreamingInfo *si;
	int streamId;
	int i;

	for(si = ms_startRequestedList.m_next; si != &ms_endRequestedList; si = si->m_next){
		streamId = si - ms_aInfoForModel;
		if(DoesModelUseTxdInHierarchy(streamId, txdId))
			return true;
	}

	for(i = 0; i < 4; i++){
		streamId = ms_channel[0].streamIds[i];
		if(DoesModelUseTxdInHierarchy(streamId, txdId))
			return true;
		streamId = ms_channel[1].streamIds[i];
		if(DoesModelUseTxdInHierarchy(streamId, txdId))
			return true;
	}

	return false;
}

bool
CStreaming::AreAnimsUsedByRequestedModels(int32 animId)
{
	CStreamingInfo *si;
	int streamId;
	int i;

	for(si = ms_startRequestedList.m_next; si != &ms_endRequestedList; si = si->m_next){
		streamId = si - ms_aInfoForModel;
		if(streamId < STREAM_OFFSET_TXD){
			CBaseModelInfo *reqInfo = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(streamId);
			if(reqInfo && reqInfo->GetAnimFileIndex() == animId)
				return true;
		}
	}

	for(i = 0; i < 4; i++){
		streamId = ms_channel[0].streamIds[i];
		if(streamId != -1 && streamId < STREAM_OFFSET_TXD){
			CBaseModelInfo *ch0Info = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(streamId);
			if(ch0Info && ch0Info->GetAnimFileIndex() == animId)
				return true;
		}
		streamId = ms_channel[1].streamIds[i];
		if(streamId != -1 && streamId < STREAM_OFFSET_TXD){
			CBaseModelInfo *ch1Info = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(streamId);
			if(ch1Info && ch1Info->GetAnimFileIndex() == animId)
				return true;
		}
	}

	return false;
}

int32
CStreaming::GetAvailableVehicleSlot(void)
{
	int i;
	for(i = 0; i < MAXVEHICLESLOADED; i++)
		if(ms_vehiclesLoaded[i] == -1)
			return i;
	return -1;
}

bool
CStreaming::AddToLoadedVehiclesList(int32 modelId)
{
	int i;
	int id;

	if(ms_numVehiclesLoaded < desiredNumVehiclesLoaded){
		// still room for vehicles
		for(i = 0; i < MAXVEHICLESLOADED; i++){
			if(ms_vehiclesLoaded[ms_lastVehicleDeleted] == -1)
				break;
			ms_lastVehicleDeleted++;
			if(ms_lastVehicleDeleted == MAXVEHICLESLOADED)
				ms_lastVehicleDeleted = 0;
		}
		assert(ms_vehiclesLoaded[ms_lastVehicleDeleted] == -1);
		ms_numVehiclesLoaded++;
	}else{
		// find vehicle we can remove
		for(i = 0; i < MAXVEHICLESLOADED; i++){
			id = ms_vehiclesLoaded[ms_lastVehicleDeleted];
			if(id != -1 && CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(id) != nil && CanRemoveModel(id) &&
			   CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(id)->GetNumRefs() == 0)
				goto found;
			ms_lastVehicleDeleted++;
			if(ms_lastVehicleDeleted == MAXVEHICLESLOADED)
				ms_lastVehicleDeleted = 0;
		}
		id = -1;
found:
		if(id == -1){
			// didn't find anything, try a free slot
			id = GetAvailableVehicleSlot();
			if(id == -1)
				return false;	// still no luck
			ms_lastVehicleDeleted = id;
			// this is more than we wanted actually
			ms_numVehiclesLoaded++;
		}
		else{
			RemoveModel(id);
			CVehicleModelInfo* pVehicleInfo = (CVehicleModelInfo*)CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(id);
			if (pVehicleInfo->m_vehicleClass != -1)
				CCarCtrl::RemoveFromLoadedVehicleArray(id, pVehicleInfo->m_vehicleClass);
		}
	}

	ms_vehiclesLoaded[ms_lastVehicleDeleted++] = modelId;
	if(ms_lastVehicleDeleted == MAXVEHICLESLOADED)
		ms_lastVehicleDeleted = 0;
	CVehicleModelInfo* pVehicleInfo = (CVehicleModelInfo*)CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(modelId);
	// SA CStreaming::AddToLoadedVehiclesList (0x408000) starts the usage counter
	// of a freshly loaded vehicle at zero: the group sorting and the
	// least-used pick both read it, so a model that has just come in must not
	// inherit the count of the model it replaced.
	pVehicleInfo->m_nTimesUsed = 0;
	if (pVehicleInfo->m_vehicleClass != -1)
		CCarCtrl::AddToLoadedVehicleArray(modelId, pVehicleInfo->m_vehicleClass, pVehicleInfo->m_frequency);
	return true;
}

bool
CStreaming::IsObjectInCdImage(int32 id)
{
	uint32 posn, size;
	return ms_aInfoForModel[id].GetCdPosnAndSize(posn, size);
}

void
CStreaming::SetModelIsDeletable(int32 id)
{
	ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_flags &= ~STREAMFLAGS_DONT_REMOVE;
	if ((id >= STREAM_OFFSET_TXD && id < STREAM_OFFSET_COL || CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(id) == nil ||
	    CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(id)->GetModelType() != MITYPE_VEHICLE) &&
	   (ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_flags & STREAMFLAGS_SCRIPTOWNED) == 0){
		if(ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_loadState != STREAMSTATE_LOADED)
			RemoveModel(id);
		else if(ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_next == nil)
			ms_aInfoForModel[id].AddToList(&ms_startLoadedList);
	}
}

void
CStreaming::SetModelTxdIsDeletable(int32 id)
{
	CBaseModelInfo *txdOwner = CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(id);
	if(txdOwner == nil)
		return;
	SetModelIsDeletable(txdOwner->GetTxdSlot() + STREAM_OFFSET_TXD);
}

void
CStreaming::SetMissionDoesntRequireModel(int32 id)
{
	ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_flags &= ~STREAMFLAGS_SCRIPTOWNED;
	if ((id >= STREAM_OFFSET_TXD || CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(id) == nil ||
	    CModelInfo::GetModelInfo(id)->GetModelType() != MITYPE_VEHICLE) &&
	   (ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_flags & STREAMFLAGS_DONT_REMOVE) == 0){
		if(ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_loadState != STREAMSTATE_LOADED)
			RemoveModel(id);
		else if(ms_aInfoForModel[id].m_next == nil)
			ms_aInfoForModel[id].AddToList(&ms_startLoadedList);
	}
}
