```cpp
#ifndef __GTA_CUSTOMMODELS_H__
#define __GTA_CUSTOMMODELS_H__

// Runtime loader for custom resources:
// - PC (#ifndef ANDROID):
//   custom/anim/*.ifp                  animation banks
//   custom/img/*.{img,dir}             VC IMG v1 with DFF/TXD/COL/CLS entries
//   custom/data/maps/*.{ide,ipl}       loose world definitions/placements
//   custom/common.zip                  map IDE/IPL; data/peds.ide,
//                                      data/vehicles.ide, data/weapons.ide;
//                                      config.dat, timecyc.json, water.dat,
//                                      carcols.dat, lods.info (all under data/)
// - Android and desktop CUSTOM_BPC (GL3 uses the shared TexDB path):
//   custom/zip/common.bpc              20-byte XOR stream archive with config.dat,
//                                      texdb.dat, lods.info, IDE/IPL, .ani
//   custom/zip/mesh/*.bpc              mounted strictly from CDIMAGE in config.dat
//                                      (.mod head-TEA models, .cls, .ani)
//   custom/zip/textures/*.astc.bpc     mounted strictly from TEXDB in texdb.dat
//                                      (+ .tmb companions); .btx KTX1/ASTC uploaded
//                                      directly to GPU without .txd conversion.

#include <vector>
#include <stddef.h>
#include "BRVehicleResources.h"

class CCustomModels
{
public:
	// scans the custom folder (also done automatically on the first request)
	static void Initialise(void);
	static void Shutdown(void);
	// Mount every VC IMG v1 (.img + sibling .dir) under custom/img/
	// before Streaming::Init indexes filenames. DFF/TXD use the native
	// streamer; COL/CLS are validated and converted to VC COLL separately.
	// IFP entries inside IMG are ignored.
	static void ResetImageMounts(void);
	static void MountImages(void);
	static bool IsAutoMountedImage(int index);
	// Return the winning IMG index for model.txd when model.dff and its
	// same-named TXD both come from auto-mounted IMGs; they may be in different
	// archives. -1 means use the ordinary IDE TXD. Metadata only, no decoding.
	static int PairedImageTxd(const char *modelName);
	static bool HasImageTxd(const char *txdName);
	static void EnsureVehicleTxdLoaded(void);
	// Independent GPU resources: caller owns one ref, release with RwTextureDestroy.
	// Palette is an explicit row-major 16x16 RGBA table, not a guessed four-colour layout.
	static RwTexture *CreateVehiclePaletteTexture(const RwRGBA *entries, size_t count);
	static RwTexture *CreateVehicleTonerTexture(const RwRGBA &colour);
	// Reads a file that lives in common.bpc (or the loose custom/ tree as a
	// fallback). The archive is the game's own data set, so a caller that can
	// name the file gets the same bytes the client itself would use.
	static bool ReadCommonDataFile(const char *path, std::vector<uint8> &out);
	// True when the path is one this game is prepared to take from the archive
	// rather than from the Vice City directory.
	static bool IsReadableCommonDataFile(const char *path);
	// BR carmods.dat metadata; call after IDE registration. No eager loading of all mods.
	static bool LoadVehicleUpgrades(void);
	// SA CVehicleModelInfo::LoadVehicleUpgrades, archive half. The custom
	// archives carry their own carmods.dat in the BR column layout (id, vehicle,
	// slot, dummy name, model, stock parts). The SA reader in VehicleModelInfo
	// fills the same per-model tables from the game's DATA\CARMODS.DAT; this
	// walks the archive's table once and fills the slots the SA table left
	// empty, so a car defined only in an archive can still be tuned. Both paths
	// write CVehicleModelInfo::m_anUpgrades, which is the single table the
	// fitting code reads.
	static void ApplyVehicleUpgradesToModels(void);
	static void GetVehicleUpgrades(int32 vehicle, std::vector<brvehicle::Upgrade> &out);
	static bool RequestVehicleUpgrade(int32 vehicle, int32 uniqueId);
	// Nonblocking. Returns a cloned RW object and pins its model until Release.
	// Caller handles attachment to the named dummy; no physics/collision changes.
	static RwObject *CreateVehicleUpgradeInstance(int32 vehicle, int32 uniqueId);
	static void ReleaseVehicleUpgradeInstance(RwObject *object);
	// Before destroying a parent clump, release its instances; global cleanup
	// runs before world/model shutdown, not after their frames have been freed.
	static void ClearVehicleUpgrades(void);
	// Script special models may request DFFs without an IDE, or DFFs already
	// bound to another IDE slot. Locate the highest-priority mounted IMG record
	// by name without reading any model bytes; result is sector position/size.
	static bool FindModelDffInImage(const char *modelName, uint32 &position, uint32 &sectors);
	// Transfer a streamed custom TXD into a bounded GPU-resident LRU on
	// eviction. Returns false when Streaming must destroy the TXD normally.
	static bool RetainTxdOnUnload(int32 slot);
	// Called when a TXD is explicitly destroyed or its slot is recycled.
	static void ForgetTxdSlot(int32 slot);
	// Flush detached GPU objects BEFORE the RenderWare device shuts down.
	static void ClearGraphicsCache(void);
	// Temporarily force a streamed model to come from the game's own IMG. Used
	// to keep a native VC ped skeleton available when a custom SA ped replaces
	// every initially loaded reference model.
	static void SetNativeModelOverride(int32 modelId, bool enabled);
	// true when at least one of the explicit custom sources is active
	static bool IsActive(void);

	// Is this stream id served by the custom folder? The game asks this before
	// every read, so it has to stay cheap. Stream ids are models, texture
	// dictionaries and collision slots.
	static bool CanServe(int32 streamId);
	// Retained bounded worker for legacy converters. Runtime IMG contents
	// are served by the native streamer; these entry points never read ZIP.
	static void PrefetchStream(int32 streamId, bool priority = false);
	static bool IsStreamPrepared(int32 streamId, bool wait);
	static void CancelStreamPrefetch(int32 streamId);
	static void PumpBackgroundResults(void);
#ifdef CUSTOM_BPC_TEXDB
	struct GpuTerrainSplatInfo {
		RwTexture *layers[4];
		float scale[4];
	};
	static bool FindGpuTerrainSplat(const RwTexture *maskTex, GpuTerrainSplatInfo &out);
	static void BeginBlockingLoad(void);
	static void EndBlockingLoad(void);
	struct ScopedBlockingLoad {
		ScopedBlockingLoad(void) { BeginBlockingLoad(); }
		~ScopedBlockingLoad(void) { EndBlockingLoad(); }
	};
	static void BeginImmediateTextures(void);
	static void EndImmediateTextures(void);
	static void UpgradeModelTexturesImmediate(int32 modelId);
	struct ScopedImmediateTextures {
		ScopedImmediateTextures(void) { BeginImmediateTextures(); }
		~ScopedImmediateTextures(void) { EndImmediateTextures(); }
	};
#endif
	// Reads, converts and installs the file of this stream id. Only call it
	// when CanServe said yes for the same id.
	static bool Load(int32 streamId);

	// Per-model collision block from user IMG COL/CLS (false when absent).
	static bool GetCollisionBlock(const char *modelname, std::vector<uint8> &out);

	// Serve an .ifp from custom/anim/; VC banks still use native assets.
	static bool LoadAnimFileFromCustom(const char *filename, std::vector<uint8> &out);

	// Every animation bank the custom archives provide, in index order. An SA
	// installation keeps its whole movement set in custom/zip/mesh/*.bpc, so
	// the dictionary has to be built from what is actually there rather than
	// from a fixed list of file names.
	typedef void (*AnimBankCallback)(const char *bankName, void *context);
	static void ForEachAnimBank(AnimBankCallback callback, void *context);

	// Loose world files are only scanned under custom/data/maps/. The one
	// permitted ZIP also supplies data/peds.ide, data/vehicles.ide and
	// data/weapons.ide. The optional active_ipl.txt selects IPLs; IDEs are
	// always loaded.
	typedef void (*WorldFileCallback)(const char *path, const unsigned char *data,
	                                  size_t size, void *context);
	static bool HasWorldFiles(void);
	static bool ReplacesNativeWorldMap(void);
	static bool HasModelFile(const char *name);
	static void ForEachWorldFile(bool ide, WorldFileCallback callback, void *context);

	// Per-model CED2 collision blocks from .cls entries in user IMGs.
	typedef void (*CollisionCallback)(const char *model, const unsigned char *block,
	                                  size_t size, void *context);
	static void ForEachBrCollision(CollisionCallback callback, void *context);
	// Per-model blocks from user IMG .col and legacy .cls entries.
	// Callback bytes are complete, validated VC COLL blocks.
	typedef bool (*CollisionFilter)(const char *model, void *context);
	static void ForEachGameCollision(CollisionCallback callback, void *context,
	                                 CollisionFilter filter = nullptr);

	// Named tables including carmods.dat, timecyc.json, water.dat and carcols.dat can be
	// served here. Timecyc uses loose custom/data/timecyc.json if the ZIP
	// entry is absent/unreadable; water and colours are ZIP-only and fall
	// back to the game's native data when absent/unusable.
	// fromCommon means it came from that ZIP, never game-root common/.
	static bool ReadDataFile(const char *relpath, std::vector<uint8> &out,
	                         bool *fromCommon = nullptr);

	// Legacy frontend entry points; no custom skin images are indexed.
	static bool HasSkin(const char *skinname);
	// Legacy entry point (no .btx sources are indexed in this layout).
	static RwTexture *SkinTextureFromBtx(const char *skinname);
	static bool GetSkinImage(const char *skinname, std::vector<uint8> &out, char *ext, int extCap);
	static int GetNumSkins(void);
	// "name.bmp" style - the frontend skin list strips the extension itself
	static const char *GetSkinFileName(int i);

	// diagnostics (written to the always-on debug.log, see DebugLog.h)
	static void PrintStats(void);
	// Reports how many of the indexed .btx a model names and which names the
	// archives cannot satisfy. Safe to call at any time after indexing.
	static void LogTextureUsage(void);
};

#endif // __GTA_CUSTOMMODELS_H__
```

```cpp
#include "common.h"

#include "templates.h"
#include "TxdStore.h"
#include "2dEffect.h"
#include "BaseModelInfo.h"
#include "ModelInfo.h"
#include "ColModel.h"

CBaseModelInfo::CBaseModelInfo(ModelInfoType type)
{
	m_colModel = nil;
	m_2dEffectsID = -1;
	m_objectId = -1;
	m_refCount = 0;
	m_txdSlot = -1;
	m_type = type;
	m_num2dEffects = 0;
	m_bOwnsColModel = false;
	m_nVehicleMod = VEHICLE_MOD_NONE;
	m_bUsesVehDummy = false;
}

void
CBaseModelInfo::Shutdown(void)
{
	DeleteCollisionModel();
	DeleteRwObject();
	m_2dEffectsID = -1;
	m_num2dEffects = 0;
	m_txdSlot = -1;
	m_objectId = -1;
}

void
CBaseModelInfo::DeleteCollisionModel(void)
{
	if(m_colModel && m_bOwnsColModel){
		if(m_colModel)
			delete m_colModel;
		m_colModel = nil;
	}
}

void
CBaseModelInfo::AddRef(void)
{
	m_refCount++;
	AddTexDictionaryRef();
}

void
CBaseModelInfo::RemoveRef(void)
{
	m_refCount--;
	RemoveTexDictionaryRef();
}

void
CBaseModelInfo::SetTexDictionary(const char *name)
{
	int slot = CTxdStore::FindTxdSlot(name);
	if(slot == -1)
		slot = CTxdStore::AddTxdSlot(name);
	m_txdSlot = slot;
}

void
CBaseModelInfo::AddTexDictionaryRef(void)
{
	CTxdStore::AddRef(m_txdSlot);
}

void
CBaseModelInfo::RemoveTexDictionaryRef(void)
{
	CTxdStore::RemoveRef(m_txdSlot);
}

void
CBaseModelInfo::Init2dEffects(void)
{
	m_2dEffectsID = -1;
	m_num2dEffects = 0;
}

void
CBaseModelInfo::Add2dEffect(C2dEffect *fx)
{
	if(m_2dEffectsID >= 0)
		m_num2dEffects++;
	else{
		m_2dEffectsID = CModelInfo::Get2dEffectStore().GetIndex(fx);
		m_num2dEffects = 1;
	}
}

C2dEffect*
CBaseModelInfo::Get2dEffect(int n)
{
	if(m_2dEffectsID >= 0)
		return CModelInfo::Get2dEffectStore().GetItem(m_2dEffectsID+n);
	else
		return nil;
}

// SA CAtomicModelInfo::SetupVehicleUpgradeFlags (0x4C54C0).
//
// carmods.dat names parts by their model name, and the name is the only thing
// that says what the part is: an exhaust starts with `exh_`, a left wing panel
// with `wg_l_`, hydraulics and the stereo are named in full. The two tables are
// SA's, prefix and slot id included - the ids are the eVehicleMod values the
// shop and the fitting code switch on, so they must not be renumbered.
//
// SA also sets bUseCommonVehicleDictionary here, which makes the part's
// geometry come from the shared vehicle dictionary. reVC has one dictionary per
// model, so that part has no equivalent; what matters is the kind of part and
// whether it hangs on a dummy node.
void
CBaseModelInfo::SetupVehicleUpgradeFlags(const char *name)
{
	static const struct { const char *name; uint8 mod; } aDummyComps[] = {
		{ "chss_",   VEHICLE_MOD_REPLACEMENT_CHASSIS },
		{ "wheel_",  VEHICLE_MOD_REPLACEMENT_WHEEL },
		{ "exh_",    VEHICLE_MOD_REPLACEMENT_EXHAUST },
		{ "fbmp_",   VEHICLE_MOD_REPLACEMENT_FRONT_BUMPER },
		{ "rbmp_",   VEHICLE_MOD_REPLACEMENT_REAR_BUMPER },
		{ "misc_a_", VEHICLE_MOD_REPLACEMENT_MISC },
		{ "misc_b_", VEHICLE_MOD_REPLACEMENT_MISC + 1 },
		{ "misc_c_", VEHICLE_MOD_REPLACEMENT_MISC + 2 },
		{ nil,       VEHICLE_MOD_NONE }
	};

	static const struct { const char *name; uint8 mod; } aChassisComps[] = {
		{ "bnt_",      VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_BONNET },
		{ "bntl_",     VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_BONNET_LEFT_RIGHT },
		{ "bntr_",     VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_BONNET_LEFT_RIGHT },
		{ "spl_",      VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_SPOILER },
		{ "wg_l_",     VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_WING },
		{ "wg_r",      VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_WING },
		{ "fbb_",      VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_FRONT_BULLBAR },
		{ "bbb_",      VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_REAR_BULLBAR },
		{ "lgt_",      VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_FRONT_LIGHTS },
		{ "rf_",       VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_ROOF },
		{ "nto_",      VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_NITRO },
		{ "hydralics", VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_HYDRAULICS },
		{ "stereo",    VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_STEREO },
		{ nil,         VEHICLE_MOD_NONE }
	};

	if(name == nil || name[0] == '\0')
		return;

	for(int32 i = 0; aChassisComps[i].name; i++){
		if(strncmp(aChassisComps[i].name, name, strlen(aChassisComps[i].name)) != 0)
			continue;
		m_nVehicleMod = aChassisComps[i].mod;
		m_bUsesVehDummy = false;
		return;
	}

	for(int32 i = 0; aDummyComps[i].name; i++){
		if(strncmp(aDummyComps[i].name, name, strlen(aDummyComps[i].name)) != 0)
			continue;
		m_nVehicleMod = aDummyComps[i].mod;
		// These parts hang on a node of the car rather than on the chassis
		// slot their name spells out; the fitting code has to look the node up.
		m_bUsesVehDummy = true;
		return;
	}
}
```

```cpp
#ifndef __GTA_BASEMODELINFO_H__
#define __GTA_BASEMODELINFO_H__

struct CColModel;

#ifdef ANDROID
#define MAX_MODEL_NAME (24)
#else
#define MAX_MODEL_NAME (21)
#endif

enum ModelInfoType
{
	MITYPE_NA,
	MITYPE_SIMPLE,
	MITYPE_MLO,	// unused but still in enum
	MITYPE_TIME,
	MITYPE_WEAPON,
	MITYPE_CLUMP,
	MITYPE_VEHICLE,
	MITYPE_PED,
	MITYPE_XTRACOMPS,	// unused but still in enum
	MITYPE_HAND	// xbox and mobile
};

class C2dEffect;

// SA eVehicleMod (BaseModelInfo.h). Which kind of vehicle part a model is,
// used as the CarMod field of a bought part: it tells the fitting code which
// panel the part belongs to and which panel it repairs when bought.
enum eVehicleMod
{
	VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_BONNET            = 0,
	VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_BONNET_LEFT_RIGHT = 1,
	VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_SPOILER           = 2,
	VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_WING              = 3,
	VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_FRONT_BULLBAR     = 4,
	VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_REAR_BULLBAR      = 5,
	VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_FRONT_LIGHTS      = 6,
	VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_ROOF              = 7,
	VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_NITRO             = 8,
	VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_HYDRAULICS        = 9,
	VEHICLE_MOD_UPGRADE_STEREO            = 10,

	VEHICLE_MOD_REPLACEMENT_CHASSIS       = 11,
	VEHICLE_MOD_REPLACEMENT_WHEEL         = 12,
	VEHICLE_MOD_REPLACEMENT_EXHAUST       = 13,
	VEHICLE_MOD_REPLACEMENT_FRONT_BUMPER  = 14,
	VEHICLE_MOD_REPLACEMENT_REAR_BUMPER   = 15,
	VEHICLE_MOD_REPLACEMENT_MISC          = 16,

	VEHICLE_MOD_NONE                      = 0xFF
};

class CBaseModelInfo
{
protected:
	char         m_name[MAX_MODEL_NAME];
	uint8        m_type;
	uint8        m_num2dEffects;
	bool         m_bOwnsColModel;
	CColModel   *m_colModel;
	int16        m_2dEffectsID;
	int16        m_objectId;
	uint16       m_refCount;
	int16        m_txdSlot;

public:
	// SA CBaseModelInfo::bUseCommonVehicleDictionary / CarMod / bUsesVehDummy.
	// A model that is a vehicle part rather than a world object: which kind of
	// part it is (eVehicleMod) and whether it hangs on the dummy of a node
	// instead of on the chassis slot it names. Set by
	// SetupVehicleUpgradeFlags from the model's name, exactly as SA does.
	uint8        m_nVehicleMod;
	bool         m_bUsesVehDummy;

public:
	CBaseModelInfo(ModelInfoType type);
	virtual ~CBaseModelInfo() {}
	virtual void Shutdown(void);
	virtual void DeleteRwObject(void) = 0;
	virtual RwObject *CreateInstance(void) = 0;
	virtual RwObject *CreateInstance(RwMatrix *) = 0;
	virtual RwObject *GetRwObject(void) = 0;
	virtual void SetAnimFile(const char *file) {}
	virtual void ConvertAnimFileIndex(void) {}
	virtual int GetAnimFileIndex(void) { return -1; }

	// one day it becomes virtual
	uint8 GetModelType() const { return m_type; }
	bool IsBuilding(void) { return m_type == MITYPE_SIMPLE || m_type == MITYPE_TIME; }
	bool IsSimple(void) { return m_type == MITYPE_SIMPLE || m_type == MITYPE_TIME || m_type == MITYPE_WEAPON; }
	bool IsClump(void) { return m_type == MITYPE_CLUMP || m_type == MITYPE_PED || m_type == MITYPE_VEHICLE;	}
	char *GetModelName(void) { return m_name; }
	void SetModelName(const char *name) { strncpy(m_name, name, MAX_MODEL_NAME - 1); m_name[MAX_MODEL_NAME - 1] = '\0'; }
	void SetColModel(CColModel *col, bool owns = false){
		m_colModel = col; m_bOwnsColModel = owns; }
	CColModel *GetColModel(void) { return m_colModel; }
	bool DoesOwnColModel(void) { return m_bOwnsColModel; }
	void DeleteCollisionModel(void);
	void ClearTexDictionary(void) { m_txdSlot = -1; }
	int16 GetObjectID(void) { return m_objectId; }
	void SetObjectID(int16 id) { m_objectId = id; }
	int16 GetTxdSlot(void) { return m_txdSlot; }
	void AddRef(void);
	void RemoveRef(void);
	void SetTexDictionary(const char *name);
	void AddTexDictionaryRef(void);
	void RemoveTexDictionaryRef(void);
	// SA CAtomicModelInfo::SetupVehicleUpgradeFlags (0x4C54C0). Classifies a
	// vehicle part model from its name: which eVehicleMod it is and whether it
	// hangs on a node dummy. Called by CVehicleModelInfo::LoadVehicleUpgrades
	// for every name carmods.dat lists.
	void SetupVehicleUpgradeFlags(const char *name);
	void Init2dEffects(void);
	void Add2dEffect(C2dEffect *fx);
	C2dEffect *Get2dEffect(int n);
	uint8 GetNum2dEffects() const { return m_num2dEffects; }
	uint16 GetNumRefs() const { return m_refCount; }
};

#endif // __GTA_BASEMODELINFO_H__
```

```cpp
#endif

int8 CVehicleModelInfo::ms_compsToUse[2] = { -2, -2 };
int8 CVehicleModelInfo::ms_compsUsed[2];
RwRGBA CVehicleModelInfo::ms_vehicleColourTable[256];
RwTexture *CVehicleModelInfo::ms_colourTextureTable[256];

// SA per-model tuning state. The lists are shared between models the way SA
// shares them: a model's own table lives in its model info, but the wheel sets
// and the link list describe the whole catalogue and are filled once from
// carmods.dat.
CVehicleModelInfo::CLinkedUpgradeList CVehicleModelInfo::ms_linkedUpgrades;
uint8 CVehicleModelInfo::ms_currentCol[NUM_CURRENT_COLORS] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 };
RwTexture *CVehicleModelInfo::ms_pRemapTexture;
int16 CVehicleModelInfo::ms_numWheelUpgrades[NUM_WHEELS];
int16 CVehicleModelInfo::ms_upgradeWheels[NUM_WHEELS][NUM_WHEEL_UPGRADES];
int32 CVehicleModelInfo::ms_wheelFrameIDs[NUM_WHEELS] = {
	CAR_WHEEL_RF, CAR_WHEEL_RM, CAR_WHEEL_RB, CAR_WHEEL_LF
};

RwTexture *gpWhiteTexture;
static RwTexture *gpFallbackEnvTexture;
RwFrame *pMatFxIdentityFrame;

// true while the currently processed vehicle model uses the GTA:San Andreas
// node naming convention (see "GTA:San Andreas vehicle support" below).
// Always false unless SA_VEHICLE_MODELS is defined.
static bool gVehicleIsSAHierarchy;

enum {
	VEHICLE_FLAG_COLLAPSE	= 0x2,
	VEHICLE_FLAG_ADD_WHEEL	= 0x4,
	VEHICLE_FLAG_POS	= 0x8,
	VEHICLE_FLAG_DOOR	= 0x10,
	VEHICLE_FLAG_LEFT	= 0x20,
	VEHICLE_FLAG_RIGHT	= 0x40,
	VEHICLE_FLAG_FRONT	= 0x80,
	VEHICLE_FLAG_REAR	= 0x100,
	VEHICLE_FLAG_COMP	= 0x200,
	VEHICLE_FLAG_DRAWLAST	= 0x400,
	VEHICLE_FLAG_WINDSCREEN	= 0x800,
	// SA dummy position, stored in the upper bits of flags as
	// (eVehicleDummy + 1) << VEHICLE_FLAG_DUMMY_SHIFT. 0 means "not a dummy".
	VEHICLE_FLAG_DUMMY	= 0x1000,
	VEHICLE_FLAG_DUMMY_SHIFT = 16,
	VEHICLE_FLAG_ANGLECULL	= 0x1000,
	VEHICLE_FLAG_REARDOOR	= 0x2000,
	VEHICLE_FLAG_FRONTDOOR	= 0x4000,
};

RwObjectNameIdAssocation carIds[] = {
	// SA CVehicleModelInfo name table, in eCarNodes order. The order matters:
	// SetFrameIds walks this table and assigns hierarchy ids in sequence, so the
	// nth entry lands on frame id n. That is why CAR_CHASSIS sits at index 1 and
```
